description: Split agents: Stage 1 infers values (no ranking). Stage 2 ranks using ONLY those inferred values.

stage_1_inferred_values.name: Democratic Participation & Engagement
stage_1_inferred_values.description: Enables citizens to meaningfully participate in governance decisions, policy formation, or civic processes.
stage_1_inferred_values.evidence_indicators: Features enabling voting, consultation, proposal development; documented user participation; adoption by government bodies

stage_1_inferred_values.name: Transparency & Accountability
stage_1_inferred_values.description: Makes government actions, decisions, data, or processes visible and subject to public scrutiny.
stage_1_inferred_values.evidence_indicators: Publishes government data, voting records, budgets, procurement decisions; tracks implementation; exposes decision-making

stage_1_inferred_values.name: Data Access & Openness
stage_1_inferred_values.description: Provides open access to civic/government data, APIs, or information infrastructure.
stage_1_inferred_values.evidence_indicators: Open APIs; published datasets; reusable standards; removal of paywalls; adoption by third-party developers

stage_1_inferred_values.name: Technical Infrastructure & Replicability
stage_1_inferred_values.description: Provides open-source tools, standards, or platforms that can be adopted, adapted, and deployed by others.
stage_1_inferred_values.evidence_indicators: Open-source codebase; deployment documentation; multi-country adoption; active developer community; interoperability

stage_1_inferred_values.name: Investigative & Accountability Journalism
stage_1_inferred_values.description: Supports research, investigation, and evidence gathering enabling exposure of wrongdoing.
stage_1_inferred_values.evidence_indicators: Used in published investigations; evidence of uncovering corruption; fact-checking tools; adopted by news organisations

stage_1_inferred_values.name: Rights Protection
stage_1_inferred_values.description: Protects individual or collective rights including digital privacy, security, freedom of expression.
stage_1_inferred_values.evidence_indicators: Encryption/anonymity features; protection against surveillance; use by at-risk groups; security audits

stage_1_inferred_values.name: Measurable Democratic Outcomes
stage_1_inferred_values.description: Demonstrates concrete evidence that the technology produces changes in civic participation, policy, or governance.
stage_1_inferred_values.evidence_indicators: Quantified user engagement; policy changes influenced; documented behavioral change; independent evaluation

stage_1_inferred_values.name: Accessibility to Marginalised/Underserved Populations
stage_1_inferred_values.description: Addresses civic technology gaps for resource-constrained environments and underrepresented communities.
stage_1_inferred_values.evidence_indicators: Deployment in low-resource contexts; multilingual support; offline capability; low technical barriers; documented use by underserved populations

abstentions.name: Matrix
abstentions.reason: Insufficient evidence of democratic outcomes; unclear civic mission vs infrastructure play

abstentions.name: Campaign Tracker
abstentions.reason: Unclear mapping to V3-V8; primarily national UK tool with limited documentation

abstentions.name: Cybersecurity for Democracy
abstentions.reason: Research org rather than deployed tool; V5 partial but limited replicability evidence

abstentions.name: Democracy Club Developer API
abstentions.reason: Strong V3 but metadata incomplete for V7 and V8 assessment

abstentions.name: OPORA
abstentions.reason: Strong election monitoring but insufficient data on rights protection and accessibility

abstentions.name: Creative Commons
abstentions.reason: V3 and V4 strong but not explicitly civic/political — infrastructure layer below the Politech scope
